dependency_resolution.same_release_availability_rule: BUILD-PLAN separates compiled public implementation and applicable static checks from full future acceptance. R0.K4a consumes K3 implementation availability; this does not pass K3 runtime ATs or installed-identity gates.
dependency_resolution.current_k3_route: The original source snapshot showed offline help/version and parsing only. On the latest captured snapshot, production status/doctor call OpsControlRead and return explicit NOT_IMPLEMENTED owner probes/capabilities; test-environment status/doctor remains attestation-gated. Stack, test clock, and registered-probe invocations still lack owner transports and return DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. R0.K3 evidence remains labeled offline/parser-only.
dependency_resolution.status_doctor_source_delta: The parent added the public diagnostic adapter and safe Ops projections during this design review (docs/adr/0008-ops-control-read-bootstrap.md). Those reads report unavailable owners; they do not supply stack lifecycle, probe transport, or K4a receipts.
dependency_resolution.k4a_current_route: R0.K4a preparation lists four unimplemented references and requires a registered test stack, sealed case IDs, and public toy.cli.v1 operation/report receipts. No K4a case IDs or public receipts are present.
dependency_resolution.candidate_bootstrap: A dedicated one-shot App Sandbox test launcher may execute the disposable R0 stack under the actual invoking UID/GID recorded from the OS. It never impersonates _toy_agent and proves no installed-service identity predicate. This exact K3 launcher/manifest is not yet frozen or executable.
dependency_resolution.actual_service_gates: R0.04 measures service identities/protected parents/recovery; R0.05 runs the declared denial matrix as actual _toy_agent. Both remain pending and independent from caller-UID K4a receipts.

launcher_design.purpose: fixed registered R0 test stack only; no production activation
launcher_design.process_identity: actual invoking OS UID/GID, read back independently; no setuid, sudo, su, --uid, --as, or UserName override
launcher_design.stack_lifecycle_owner: Ops must freeze one bounded owner-supervised controller/lifecycle contract across separate stack up and probe run/show/down CLI invocations. An inherited pipe only spans its creating process tree; PostgreSQL must not be left detached or controlled through an undeclared local socket. No such K3 contract is implemented.
launcher_design.signature: local ad-hoc code signature; seal launcher and complete helper closure, verify strict signature and entitlements at every admission; signature is not runtime denial evidence
launcher_design.network: no App Sandbox network entitlements, DNS, TCP listeners, Internet, provider endpoints, or live secrets
launcher_design.ipc: fixed bounded framed inherited pipes only; stdout protocol-only, stderr redacted; close all undeclared inherited descriptors
launcher_design.database: private PostgreSQL 17.11 child and durable data ownership bound to one stack generation, database toy/schema pgboss, listen_addresses empty, per-stack socket under the private sandbox container; exact App Sandbox socket viability and cross-invocation lifecycle/control are unresolved and must fail closed if unavailable

commands: toy --env test stack up --release R0 --request-id <UUID> --world <registered-world-id> --clock fake --model fake --json
public_receipt_plan.pass_boundary: Only complete registered public-case receipts with full artifact binding can verify K4a references. Source hashes, compilation, codesign verification, help/version, or this ADR remain preparation/static evidence. No current receipt or AT verdict is recorded.

unresolved_technical_predicates: Ops has not frozen the K3-specific test bundle identifier, artifact path, manifest schema, or internal frame schema.

K3 has no frozen owner/controller contract for a stack generation spanning separate CLI invocations. Inherited pipes do not persist as control between calls, and no source authorizes an unowned/detached PostgreSQL process or another local control transport.
No runtime evidence shows the full local ad-hoc-signed parent bundle launches under this host's current macOS policy.

No source-backed runtime evidence shows PostgreSQL 17.11 can use the per-stack Unix socket inside this App Sandbox with network entitlements absent. Ops §5.1's no-Unix-socket-service rule is specific to the R5 target worker and does not authorize this K3 path.
The previously recorded R5 sandbox probe failed before parent or child entry markers; it cannot establish sandbox enforcement or this R0 path.
No resource, stack ownership, restart, teardown, or K4a public-probe receipt exists.
R0.04 numeric service UIDs/GIDs and R0.05 actual _toy_agent denial/positive evidence remain unmeasured.

human_only_steps.test_launcher_signing_or_install: No explicit user-only signing or installer step is source-required for the local test launcher. Ops §5.1 specifies ad-hoc local signing without paid membership, but this design does not sign or install anything.
human_only_steps.r0_04: BUILD-PLAN names only an unavoidable macOS administrator identity dialog; builder performs setup.
human_only_steps.r0_05: No human step is listed except a recovery/login interaction the OS actually requires.

primary_research.fact: Apple documents a helper executable embedded in a sandboxed macOS app, shows an ad-hoc - signature for a locally built helper, and describes the helper's inherited sandbox configuration.
primary_research.limit: The distribution example re-signs the helper with the parent application's signing identity; it does not prove this exact full ad-hoc R0 bundle will launch under local host policy.

primary_research.fact: A child configured to inherit App Sandbox uses exactly app-sandbox and inherit; specifying another App Sandbox key aborts that child. Inheritance applies to the parent's static entitlements.
primary_research.limit: Entitlement configuration alone does not prove runtime enforcement.

primary_research.fact: App Sandbox limits access to files, network and hardware; a sandboxed app has access to its container and an embedded command-line tool must inherit the containing app's sandbox.
primary_research.limit: This source does not prove PostgreSQL's exact per-stack AF_UNIX behavior in the proposed launcher.

primary_research.fact: App Sandbox evaluates entitlements sealed into a code signature; code signing seals bytes but does not prove the code is safe or that runtime denial behavior is correct.
primary_research.limit: Gatekeeper policy is separate from the entitlement/runtime question.
